name: New project option is gone
description:
1. Request: add a "New Project" entry point to `AppsSection.vue` and `MainMenu`, and make the new project modal actually open.
2. Discovery: `MainMenuItems.vue` already rendered a "New project" item calling `$ui.showNewProject(true)`; `AppsSection.vue` had no such item; `src/store/ui.js` and `NewProject.vue` already existed but were unwired.
3. Root cause: the current `src/App.vue` no longer rendered the global `<NewProject>` modal, so the `$ui.newProject` flag triggered nothing — clicking any "New project" launcher did nothing.
4. Fix proposed: added a `New Project` `NavItem` + `handleNewProject()` method to `AppsSection.vue`, and re-mounted the global `<modal v-if="$ui.newProject">` with `<NewProject />` in `App.vue`.
5. Outcome: no change needed in `MainMenu` (already correct); "New Project" now works uniformly from the sidebar, dropdown menu, Windows menu, and QuickBar.
